sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link preview window: a new "✎ Editing history" button (or press H) shows the entity's editing history in the same window, laid out like a Discogs release's history. Every entity with an MBID has one (not a collection), and so does an editor. The list has one row per edit (date, editor, a coloured type pill, what changed with the editor's note, votes or status), with chips for category and status and a Newest/Oldest switch. Click a row (or use ↑ ↓) to see that edit below: old and new values side by side with MusicBrainz's red/green marks, an edit medium's tracklist split into its old and new halves, a merge as Merge | Into, an addition or removal in one column, then the edit notes. "Only what changed" is on by default. Cover and event art open in the artwork viewer, "Edit #…" opens the edit's own card in the window, and ← Back returns.

"Load page 2 of 7" reads the next 50 edits. A busy entity only says "at least 500", so its footer has no last page. Each page is one request and selecting a row asks for nothing. A page with an open edit is read again next time, because its votes change. Logged out, the window says that MusicBrainz hides editors and notes.
The sidebar's "Editing history" link and an editor window's "Their edits" link now have a card of their own and open the same window.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A dialog no longer closes when a button inside it is pressed with the keyboard (Enter on a focused chip in a Discogs history window, for example) and the button redraws its part of the dialog.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: An edit, editor or tag card that gets MusicBrainz's "Verifying your browser" page instead now says so: open the page once in a tab, then press ⟳.
